preconditions.description: The size of the set n must be at least 5 and at most b, which is at most 10000.
The size of the set n must be divisible by 5.
The number of hints q must be between 1 and 10000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= upTo <= b and 0 <= quantity <= n for upTo, quantity in hints)
preconditions.description: Each hint must have upTo between 1 and b, and quantity between 0 and n.

postconditions.description: If there exists at least one set satisfying all conditions and hints, output 'fair'.
If no set satisfies all conditions and hints, output 'unfair'.
